items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Vido Musso, but the interviewee does not respond or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: Vido Musso has been around with a number of orchestras and so in the St. Louis area he was a fixture on the scene or at least he would pass through a lot at that time? He came out of California, didn't he?
Yeah, he was with Stan Kenton.
